targets.outcome_computational_quote: Confirmed. Participants in the lottery condition were willing to pay less (M = $5.68, SD = $4.48, Mdn = $5.00) than participants in the gift card condition (M = $9.52, SD = $6.69, Mdn = $7.50; t(99) = 3.43, p < .001, partial eta-squared = .11). (Note: The SD values for the two groups were switched in the original article.)
